alert.name: ECSServiceAlarm
alert.summary: CloudWatch alarm fired for ECS service checkout

root_cause.hypothesis: Revision 42 deploy (image bump python:3.12-alpine → 3.12.7-alpine) at 16:58 UTC triggered new task replacements. Each new task allocates 900MiB cache on startup, hits memory pressure, and gets killed/restarted every ~30-35s — a crash loop, not a healthy rollout. tasks_running(3) > desired(2) with deployments_in_flight=2 confirms old+new tasks coexisting mid-rollout, stuck because new tasks keep failing health checks from memory pressure before stabilizing.
evidence: Deploy at 2026-09-11T22:28:18+05:30 (16:58:18 UTC) precedes first log line by ~47s — tight correlation
6 distinct task IDs each show identical pattern: started → WARN memory pressure rising → allocating 900MiB cache, then a new task starts ~30s later (implies prior task died)
deployments_in_flight=2 and tasks_pending=1 indicate the service is stuck mid-deployment, not steady-state
reported memory_utilization_pct=58.6% is a snapshot average, consistent with tasks flapping between low and high memory rather than one stable high level
cpu_utilization_pct near zero suggests tasks are dying before doing real work, not from CPU-bound load
ruled_out: Pure alarm noise / no real issue — unlikely given repeated crash-loop pattern in logs
CPU exhaustion — cpu_utilization_pct is ~0.005%, rules this out
Gradual organic memory leak unrelated to deploy — timing is too tightly coupled to the revision-42 rollout to be coincidental, though causation isn't proven from logs alone

proposal.reasoning: Rev42 deploy (16:58 UTC, python:3.12.7-alpine) triggers repeat task replace every ~30-35s. Each new task: start -> memory pressure WARN -> alloc 900MiB cache -> die. 6+ task IDs cycle in 4min window. tasks_running(3)>desired(2), deployments_in_flight=2 = old+new stuck mid-rollout, new tasks failing health checks before stabilize. Not transient — crash loop tied to new image.
proposal.expected_effect: Revert to prior stable image, new tasks stop crash-looping, deployment converges, tasks_running settles to desired(2), deployments_in_flight drops to 0.

reasons: Passed all policies. Held for operator approval before execution.
